public_rationale: The claim is about every AGI declaration Marcus himself has seen. No outside record lists those declarations, so the 'every' cannot be checked. Calling a definition 'redefining downwards' is also a judgement about which definition is the standard. The two well-known declarations I found both use looser framings. One is an OpenAI staffer's 'better than most humans at most tasks'. The other is Agüera y Arcas and Norvig's view of AGI as generality, with its flaws set aside. These fit his description, but they cannot test a universal claim about his own reading. So the claim is left unscored.
limitations: Only two example declarations were reviewed.
The Futurism publication date is approximate.
